question: Does the best prop-firm-v7 policy, run as a paper career on live data under HyroTrader 1-step rules, pass challenges, survive and pay out as the backtests suggested?
registration_note: Registered 2026-10-03, before the start. Policy chosen on historical data (prop-firm-v5..v7), so only days from the start count. Paper only: no account is bought, no order is sent. Rules: HyroTrader 1-step snapshot of 2026-10-02 (config/prop_firm_v1.json) and payout rules from config/prop_firm_v6.json.
book: multi-premia blend (config/multi_premia_blend_v1.json, 70 coins, MEXC data and funding)
challenge_policy: C05: blend scaled to 25% annual vol (30-day trailing), cap 5x, headroom scaling
funded_policy: 1.25x blend with headroom scaling (1 / 0.5 / 0.25 at >4% / 2-4% / <=2% above the max-loss floor)
withdrawal_policy: on demand as soon as profit >= 1% of the account (max 5% of the balance per payout)
career: buy a challenge on the start day; retry after any failure; trade funded until a breach, then buy again; fees and payouts tallied in % of a 100k account
outputs: events (challenge bought / passed / breached, funded breach, payouts)
current phase, equity and distance to the max-loss floor
net payouts minus fees to date
